blocks.text: Thanks for the time this morning. Here's what I heard, in your order:
Inspections that sync on their own when a tablet is back online, with no resending.
A signed PDF for every inspection, inspector signature and time, within 24 hours.
Export to your freight system, by site.

On Friday at 2 we'll show the first two: an inspection made offline syncing when the tablet reconnects, and the signed PDF for it. Export by site comes after, and I'll come back to you with real timing.
One question we didn't get to: do your inspectors ever need to change an inspection after it's signed? Our plan is that a signed inspection is never edited; a correction is a new inspection.
Benvolio Montague will send the invite.
